correctness.rationale: The exact 13 cover relations were independently closed transitively. Exhausting all \(2^9=512\) subsets yields 27 lower sets, including the empty set. Recursive beat-point reduction finds exactly eleven nonempty contractible opens; inclusion comparison has exactly two maximal elements, \(U_g\) and \(P(9)\setminus\{g\}\), and all unordered pairs contain exactly one covering pair. The full nine-point space has no beat point. This is an exhaustive finite proof, not an extrapolation.
